build_digits_classifier: build a support vector classifier on the scikit-learn digits dataset to recognize handwritten digits from 0-9
test_classification_metrics: test the scikit-learn classification report and confusion matrix on predicted versus true digit labels
create_train_test_split: create a train-test split of flattened 8x8 digit image data with configurable test size and shuffle option
plot_confusion_matrix: plot a confusion matrix display for true versus predicted digit classification results
run_digits_visualization: run a visualization of 8x8 grayscale digit images from the scikit-learn digits dataset with matplotlib
